acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system and software anchors and is verified by its named checks, traceability route, or report inspection.
statement: The task shall validate that every accepted capability-007 requirement traces from spec to system to software to component to unit to code to test/measure to evidence to intended-use validation at the exact candidate revision, and that no required relation is missing or stale.
title: Bidirectional Spec Kit traceability validation
